paragraphs: Experts say artificial intelligence, or AI, is very important for Ireland's economy. Big companies are spending huge amounts of money on AI.
Ireland's Central Bank is worried. It says money markets could be hurt if AI grows more slowly.
Irish pension funds also depend on AI. Up to €15 of every €100 goes to six big companies that work on AI. These include Nvidia, Microsoft and Amazon.
Ireland has many data centres. They used 23% of the country's electricity last year. Some local people are not happy about this.
One expert, Dr Emma Howard, thinks the AI bubble will burst one day. She says the big question is when.
sentZh: 專家說人工智慧（AI）對愛爾蘭的經濟非常重要。
大公司正在AI上花費巨額資金。
愛爾蘭中央銀行感到擔憂。
它說如果AI成長變慢，金融市場可能會受到傷害。
愛爾蘭的退休基金也依賴AI。
每100歐元中最多有15歐元投入六家從事AI的大公司。
其中包括輝達、微軟和亞馬遜。
愛爾蘭有很多資料中心。
去年它們用掉了全國23%的電力。
一些當地人對此不滿。
一位專家艾瑪・霍華德博士認為AI泡沫總有一天會破裂。
她說最大的問題是什麼時候。

paragraphs: Economists say artificial intelligence has become one of the biggest issues for Ireland's economy. Dermot O'Leary, chief economist at Goodbody, called it the biggest issue in the world economy and in financial markets.
The Central Bank of Ireland has warned that if spending on AI slows down, prices in financial markets could fall sharply. It describes AI as a key weakness for the Irish economy.

Many Irish people are already involved without knowing it. An RTÉ Prime Time study found that up to €15 of every €100 in Irish pension funds is invested in six AI-linked companies, including Nvidia, Microsoft and Amazon.
AI has also helped the economy grow. EY says it helped keep growth close to 3%, about twice the European average. But Ireland's many data centres used 23% of all electricity last year.
Dr Emma Howard of TU Dublin believes the AI bubble will burst. She says the real question is when it happens and how bad it will be.
sentZh: 經濟學家說人工智慧已成為愛爾蘭經濟最重大的議題之一。
Goodbody首席經濟學家德莫特・歐利里稱它是世界經濟和金融市場中最大的議題。
愛爾蘭中央銀行警告，如果AI支出放緩，金融市場的價格可能大幅下跌。
它將AI形容為愛爾蘭經濟的一個關鍵弱點。
許多愛爾蘭人在不知不覺中已經牽涉其中。
RTÉ《黃金時段》的一項研究發現，愛爾蘭退休基金每100歐元中最多有15歐元投資於包括輝達、微軟和亞馬遜在內的六家AI相關公司。
AI也幫助了經濟成長。
安永表示，它幫助將成長率維持在接近3%，約為歐洲平均的兩倍。
但愛爾蘭眾多的資料中心去年用掉了全部電力的23%。
都柏林理工大學的艾瑪・霍華德博士相信AI泡沫將會破裂。
她說真正的問題是它何時發生以及會有多嚴重。

paragraphs: Artificial intelligence has become the single biggest issue facing the global economy and financial markets, according to Goodbody chief economist Dermot O'Leary, and Ireland is more exposed than most countries.
The Central Bank of Ireland has described AI as a key structural vulnerability, warning that any slowdown in investment or profits could trigger a sharp repricing in financial markets.

Ordinary savers are also affected. An RTÉ Prime Time analysis found that as much as €15 of every €100 invested by Irish pension funds goes into just six AI-linked firms, including Nvidia, Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon.

On the positive side, EY says AI has helped keep domestic growth near 3%, double the European average. However, data centres consumed 23% of Ireland's electricity last year, causing frustration in local communities.
Dr Emma Howard of TU Dublin argues that the AI bubble will eventually burst, and that the only uncertainty is the timing and the scale of the damage.
sentZh: 根據Goodbody首席經濟學家德莫特・歐利里的說法，人工智慧已成為全球經濟和金融市場面臨的最大議題，而愛爾蘭受影響的程度比大多數國家都高。
愛爾蘭中央銀行將AI形容為一個關鍵的結構性弱點，並警告投資或獲利的任何放緩都可能引發金融市場的劇烈重新定價。
一般儲戶也受到影響。
RTÉ《黃金時段》的分析發現，愛爾蘭退休基金每投資100歐元，就有多達15歐元流向僅僅六家AI相關企業，包括輝達、微軟、Alphabet和亞馬遜。
從正面來看，安永表示AI幫助將國內成長維持在接近3%，是歐洲平均的兩倍。
然而，資料中心去年消耗了愛爾蘭23%的電力，引起地方社區的不滿。
都柏林理工大學的艾瑪・霍華德博士認為AI泡沫終將破裂，唯一不確定的是時間點和損害的規模。

paragraphs: Artificial intelligence now looms as the foremost issue for the global economy and financial markets, according to Goodbody chief economist Dermot O'Leary, and Ireland is unusually exposed to its fortunes.
The Central Bank of Ireland has flagged AI as a key structural vulnerability, cautioning that any faltering in investment or profitability could precipitate an abrupt repricing of financial assets.

The exposure extends to ordinary savers. An RTÉ Prime Time analysis revealed that up to €15 of every €100 held by Irish pension funds is channelled into a mere six AI-linked giants, among them Nvidia, Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon.

There is an upside, as EY credits AI with sustaining domestic growth of close to 3%, twice the European norm. Yet data centres devoured 23% of the nation's electricity last year, fuelling local resentment and regulatory pushback.
Dr Emma Howard of TU Dublin contends that the bubble is bound to burst, the only open questions being when and how severe the fallout will prove.

愛爾蘭中央銀行已將AI標示為一個關鍵的結構性弱點，並提醒投資或獲利能力的任何動搖都可能促成金融資產的急遽重新定價。
這種曝險延伸到一般儲戶。
RTÉ《黃金時段》的分析揭示，愛爾蘭退休基金每持有100歐元，就有多達15歐元被導入區區六家AI相關巨頭，其中包括輝達、微軟、Alphabet和亞馬遜。
也有好的一面，安永認為AI功在維持接近3%的國內成長，是歐洲常態的兩倍。
然而資料中心去年吞噬了全國23%的電力，加劇了地方的不滿和監管阻力。
都柏林理工大學的艾瑪・霍華德博士主張泡沫注定會破裂，唯一懸而未決的問題是何時破裂以及後果會有多嚴重。

paragraphs: According to Goodbody chief economist Dermot O'Leary, artificial intelligence represents the most significant issue confronting the global economy and financial markets, and Ireland is disproportionately exposed to its trajectory.
The Central Bank of Ireland has identified AI as a key structural vulnerability, warning that a deceleration in investment or profitability could prompt a substantial repricing of financial assets.

This exposure is not confined to institutional investors. An RTÉ Prime Time analysis indicated that up to €15 of every €100 invested by Irish pension funds is allocated to only six AI-related corporations, including Nvidia, Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon.

Admittedly, EY attributes the maintenance of domestic growth at approximately 3%, double the European average, partly to AI. Nevertheless, data centres accounted for 23% of national electricity demand last year, which has consequently generated considerable local opposition and regulatory resistance.
Dr Emma Howard of TU Dublin maintains that the bubble will inevitably burst, and that the principal uncertainties concern the timing and the magnitude of the consequences.
